title: Update a line with gradient descent
description: You connect predictions, squared error, and slope and bias updates.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You predict y with m*x+b each epoch. The loss averages squared residuals across n examples.
You compute gradients for slope m and bias b from the same residuals. The slope gradient also weights each residual by x.

steps.question: Does each printed loss use the same parameter values as the printed m and b?
steps.answer: The loss uses parameters from before the update. The print statement shows m and b after subtracting their gradient steps.

steps.description: You update both parameters and print every epoch because epoch % 1 is always zero. The supplied output shows the loss falling through epoch 30.
